  "summary": "This text introduces Tim Costello, a well-known Australian figure who has dedicated his life to fighting poverty. Here are the key points in simpler terms:",
  "key_points": [
    "Tim Costello believes that poverty is not an unavoidable force of nature, like the weather; instead, he argues it is the direct result of political choices and policies.",
    "He has spent over 30 years working to help people in need, locally and internationally, often working in dangerous or difficult situations.",
    "He has had a diverse career including serving as a mayor, writing books, and being recognized as a 'national living treasure.'",
    "He is most famous for his 13-year role as the leader of the charity World Vision and for being a prominent Baptist minister.",
    "People sometimes confuse him with his brother, Peter Costello, who was a famous government treasurer. This leads to people asking if they are meeting the 'political one' (Peter) or the 'religious one' (Tim)."
  ]
}
```
